title: Power Dialer
status: dormant (legacy system; not in the M1/M7 database yet: docs/proposals/legacy_offices.md)
brief: Legacy system: the parallel dialer and live call coach (private repo thedonnasystem/dialer) for the owner's energy sales calls. Telnyx call control, Chrome extension, Deepgram speech to text. Jarvis sees only aggregate call counts; names and phone numbers stay in the dialer's own volume. Calling rules (CRTC telemarketing rules, the National DNCL, abandoned-call limits) are the owner's legal call.

agents.title: Call analyst
agents.purpose: Reads call stats and finds the leak
agents.prompt: From aggregate counts only (dials, answers, abandoned second answers, outcomes), show where the day leaks: connect rate, pitch rate, close rate, abandon rate against the 5 percent rule. Never ask for a name or a number.

agents.title: Coach tuner
agents.prompt: Review coach test results and objection coverage. Propose script and objection-card changes as drafts for the owner; never change spend caps or calling hours.

legacy.stack: Node 20 (express, ws), Telnyx Call Control + WebRTC, Chrome MV3 extension, Deepgram, Railway

dry_run.note: The dialer's own mock Telnyx run: no call is placed.

changes.change: Owner decision (Nov 24): the dialer stays as is; the abandoned-call guard PR was closed. The abandon rate (second answers hung up on) remains visible in /qc once events.csv is exported, so the owner can re-decide with real numbers.
Log the pitched / closed outcome on every answered call so close rate per hour of dialing can be measured (events.csv has the fields; the outcome tap is often skipped).
Export events.csv weekly (GET /api/log.csv) so /qc can measure dials -> answers -> pitches -> closes per hour.
